Soojin — reviewed. Summary of legal position and recommended language: 

1) Coverage minimums: Acceptable. GL 1M/2M and E&O 5M are within our typical tolerance for mid-market customers.
2) Additional Insured: We will agree to name Acme Corp as Additional Insured on Commercial General Liability and Commercial Auto only. We do not add Additional Insured status to Professional Liability/E&O.
3) Endorsements: Provide Additional Insured endorsement (CG 20 10 or equivalent) and a Primary & Noncontributory endorsement. Add Waiver of Subrogation for Workers' Comp where applicable.
4) Endorsement name and address to use exactly as requested: Acme Corp, 200 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105.
5) Policy identifiers: It's okay to redact policy numbers on the public COI; underwriting can provide full details to procurement under NDA if needed.

I'm attaching a one-page redline that sets out the insurance language we expect to appear on the Order Form / MSA and a template endorsement. Please ask Acme if they require proof beyond the COI (e.g., carrier binder).

Next steps for Soojin: send COI + endorsement stub to Acme, include the note that Additional Insured applies to GL & Auto only, and call out the Primary & Noncontributory + WoS. If Acme pushes for AI on E&O, advise procurement to escalate — we'll need underwriting sign-off.

-Karthik
